intake.description: Heavy rain caused drains to overflow, resulting in rainwater entering the ground floor of the house. The incident caused damage to the wooden flooring and walls.
intake.severity_reason: The estimated loss is between Rs 50,000 and Rs 4,99,999 (Rs 2,40,000).

route.reason: policy number PRP-26-51327 has prefix for property; intake agent read the email as property

citations.quote: Flood: Water entering the home from overflowing rivers, lakes or drains, or from the build-up of surface rainwater.
Storm and flood: We pay for damage to the home and contents caused by storm, high winds or flood, subject to PROP-EXC-4.3.
Flood cover for the building: PROP-EXC-4.3 does not apply to damage to the home itself (PROP-DEF-1.1).

coverage.reasoning: Heavy rain caused drains to overflow and rainwater to enter the ground floor, which qualifies as a flood under PROP-DEF-1.4. PROP-COV-2.3 covers damage caused by flood subject to exclusions, and PROP-END-6.1 ensures that any exclusion regarding flood does not apply to damage to the home itself. Therefore, the damage to the wooden flooring and walls of the house is covered.

flags.fix: Ensure that all required documents from the property checklist—including the repair estimate—are either attached at intake or requested from the claimant.
Request all missing documents in one consolidated message immediately after the coverage check is completed, rather than requesting them in separate messages or after assigning the surveyor.
